{{Quote|No mistake, Rogue Leader. Those aren't accidental misfire, the Star Destroyer's definitely targeting the Corvette. The Corvette's running flank speed, with full aft deflector shields. She's being chased, all right.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] to [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The '''Mission to Morishim''' was organized by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]]. Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Meizh Vermel]] was sent to [[Morishim]] to seek out [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Bel Iblis]] to ask for peace negotiations. His [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] was captured by the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] before his message could be heard properly.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|It's time to send an emissary to the New Republic. To discuss the terms of our surrender.|Admiral Gilad Pellaeon to Captain Ardiff|<ref name="Specter" />}}
On the planet Morishim, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]], and [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]] discovered an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] and a communications center in a cave of the [[High Tatmana]]. Their attention was quickly redirected when Antilles noticed that the sensor station showed an Imperial [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]] entering the system, soon joined by a [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dorja]]'s [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] was sent by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]] to capture the corvette before Colonel Vermel could transmit its message to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==The battle==
{{Quote|Pulled it into the bay and took straight off.|Wedge Antilles|<ref name="Specter" />}}
The three Rogue Squadron [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and Calrissian reported the contact to the base, which mustered its own [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. With the other starfighters of the [[Morishim New Republic starfighter base|Morishim base]] behind them and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Bel Iblis]]' [[Peregrine (Dreadnaught-class)|''Peregrine'']] on the other side of the planet, the three [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] and Calrissian's [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|luxury yacht]], the [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] were the first line of defense. They soon realized that the [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']] was firing upon and [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] the corvette, and they moved to run interference for the ship, which they guessed to be attempting a [[Desertion|defection]]. Once the corvette was disabled and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractored]], Antilles gave up and backed his group out of range. He followed Calrissian's suggestion to use their combined communications equipment to dilute the Imperial jamming, allowing Calrissian's advanced communications suite aboard the ''Lady Luck'' to record fragments of the corvette's broadcast that were sent in for analysis.

Both Calrissian and Antilles noted the event's eerie resemblance to the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|skirmish]] over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in which Princess [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa's]] corvette had been captured by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] Star Destroyer - the first in a chain of events that would lead to the destruction of the first [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. Wondering if something similarly momentous had occurred without anyone noticing, Calrissian asked Antilles if any [[escape pod]]s had been ejected from Vermel's corvette before its capture, such as the one that had carried [[C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2]] (the latter carrying the stolen Death Star schematics) to the surface of Tatooine.

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|No one's going to pay many attention to the incident over Morishim.|Major Tierce to Moff Disra|<ref name="Specter" />}}
Vermel remained imprisoned until Pellaeon discovered that his ship had been captured by Imperial forces. Despite the ''Relentless''{{'s}} jamming, [[Zakarisz Ghent]] was able to reconstruct Vermel's transmission and pass it on to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], who met the [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] at [[Pesitiin]], establishing the preliminary diplomatic groundwork for what eventually became the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty]].
